headline: Bitcoin markdown drives record loss; revenue keeps growing
summary_short: Revenue grew 6.9% y/y to $122.4M while an $8.32B unrealized loss on bitcoin holdings drove a $8.22B net loss (-$24.45 diluted EPS), narrower than Q1's loss but a reversal from last year's GAAP profit.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 6.9% y/y to $122.4M on subscription-services growth, with gross margin at 66.6% versus 68.8% a year ago. Operating loss of $8.33B and net loss of $8.22B (-$24.45 diluted EPS) were driven almost entirely by an $8.32B unrealized mark-to-market loss on bitcoin holdings under ASU 2023-08, not operating performance; the year-ago quarter had a $14.05B unrealized gain, explaining the swing from a $10.02B profit. Sequentially the net loss narrowed from Q1's $12.54B. Cash fell to $1.71B from $2.21B q/q after the company repurchased $1.50B face value of convertible notes at an 8% discount, cutting long-term debt to $6.71B; bitcoin holdings grew 11% q/q to 846,000 BTC. No formal revenue or earnings guidance was issued.

drivers.explanation: Management framed the quarter as balance-sheet strengthening amid a bitcoin price decline: convertible debt cut 18%, USD Reserve up 12% to $2.4B, and Bitcoin Per Share up 5%, even as GAAP results showed a large loss.
Subscription-services revenue rose to $62.9M from $40.8M y/y, more than offsetting declines in product-license and product-support revenue lines on the consolidated statement of operations.
Gross margin fell to 66.6% from 68.8% y/y as cost of revenue grew faster than revenue; not explained in the release.
Operating loss reflects an $8.32B unrealized mark-to-market loss on the Company's bitcoin holdings under ASU 2023-08, not core operations; a year ago the same line was a $14.05B unrealized gain.
Net loss mirrors the operating-loss swing from the bitcoin fair-value markdown; sequentially the loss narrowed as the mark-to-market loss shrank versus Q1.
Cash fell as approximately $1.38B was used in May 2026 to repurchase $1.50B face value of convertible notes at an 8% discount to par.
Convertible-note principal fell from $8.21B to $6.71B after the Company repurchased $1.50B face value in negotiated transactions.
Stockholders' equity fell as the quarter's net loss pushed retained earnings from a $6.32B surplus at year-start to a $15.20B accumulated deficit.
Share count rose as the Company raised $2.95B via ATM sales of class A common stock during the quarter.
